401 wst.bio: Toronto electronic project 401 WST brings together producers Bambii and Bonjay's Alanna Stuart for club music rooted in dancehall and house.

4korners.bio: Toronto DJ and producer 4KORNERS, longtime official DJ for the Toronto Raptors, is known for high-energy sets and productions that connect hip-hop with global club music.

88glam.bio: Toronto rap duo 88GLAM, formed by Derek Wise and 88 Camino, helped define the city's late-2010s melodic trap sound through a run of atmospheric projects.

a l l i e.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter a l l i e makes intimate alternative R&B built around layered vocals, understated production and personal writing.

aiza.bio: Montréal-raised, Toronto-based artist Aiza makes upbeat pop and R&B informed by her Burundian heritage and theatrical performance background.

alicia moffet.bio: Québec singer-songwriter and television personality Alicia Moffet has built a bilingual catalogue of polished contemporary pop and R&B.

allan rayman.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Allan Rayman pairs a gravelly voice and shadowy alternative R&B with a deliberately mysterious visual world.

alysha brilla.bio: Ontario singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Alysha Brilla makes independently produced pop and soul with socially conscious writing and global influences.
